name: Yamin Haque
title: Embedded Software Engineer
tagline: Embedded C · Embedded Linux · Layer 2 networking · system debugging
heroIntro: I build and debug C for ARM-based carrier Ethernet switches running embedded Linux and VxWorks - Layer 2 protocols, standards-compliant implementations, and the kernel tracing it takes to make them converge reliably.
currentFocus: Around three years of C and Embedded C on carrier Ethernet switching, working command-line first with GCC, GDB and ftrace. Currently open to embedded software and systems roles.
bio:
Software Engineer (R&D) with around three years developing and debugging C / Embedded C software for ARM-based carrier Ethernet switches running embedded Linux. Experienced in Layer 2 networking, Carrier Ethernet protocols, routing and switching, network security, and standards-based protocol implementation.

Strong expertise in low-level C programming - pointers, bitwise operations, type casting, structure packing, byte-order handling and memory management. Skilled in HAL/driver integration, event-driven hardware notification handling, TCP/UDP communication, performance analysis and embedded debugging.

Comfortable with command-line, no-IDE development and debugging workflows, with a solid foundation in microcontrollers and RTOS. Familiar with AI and deep learning technologies, and experienced in collaborating with overseas engineering teams and clients using professional working English.
interests: Layer 2 and Carrier Ethernet protocol implementation
Embedded Linux internals and kernel tracing

seo.title: Yamin Haque - Embedded Software Engineer
seo.description: Embedded Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience developing, debugging, and maintaining C/Embedded C software for ARM-based systems running Embedded Linux and VxWorks. Experienced in firmware development, MCU architecture, hardware/software interfacing, peripheral communication, and low-level debugging. Hands-on experience with STM32 microcontrollers, GPIO, ADC, SPI, I2C, UART, EXTI, timers, and sensor integration through bare-metal firmware development. Strong background in embedded networking, protocol implementation, system-level troubleshooting, and standards-based development. Experienced with GDB, GCC, Wireshark, kernel tracing, and command-line development workflows. Comfortable collaborating with cross functional and overseas engineering teams to develop, test, debug, and deliver reliable embedded products.
